name: write_exact20_gates
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
# Authored scientific dispositions, not metadata ranking.
notes={
345207:('varchenko','Conjecture 6.1; Theorem 5.1', 'HOLD_STRUCTURAL','Source proves pseudoline block form; higher-dimensional leftover blocks are not fully specified by the literal record. Determinant factorization controls the product, not integral polynomial equivalence. A block elimination respecting every flat and degeneracy is unpaid. No complete prior reduction or new proof.'),
345208:('obstruction','Conjecture 1, p3','PARK_HARD','The join implication is the exact source conjecture. Classical geometric nonembeddability of simplex-skeleton joins does not prove nonvanishing of the integral van Kampen obstruction for arbitrary K,L. Need a join operation on obstruction classes with nonvanishing control; nonzero torsion classes can have zero tensor product. No valid general nonvanishing lemma obtained.'),
345363:('domination-proof','Theorem 1.1; Proposition 2.1 and proof passages','EXCLUDE_PUBLIC_PROOF','Versteegen arXiv:2212.04527v2, 2 February 2023, Theorem 1.1 exactly covers every isolate-free graph of order n with gamma_g<=3n/5. This matches the entire literal target, rather than the earlier minimum-degree-two result. Proof body/reduction and concluding strategy passages acquired/read; no independent full audit or new credit.'),
345454:('awesome','Conjecture 4, equations 18–20, pp4–5','HOLD_DEFINITIONS','The literal statement leaves a_s unspecified beyond a_0. Choosing arbitrary coefficients would trivially spoil it but is a wording counterexample, excluded from credit. Source ties a_s to earlier graph-positivity work and points to Genius conjectures and a forthcoming implication. Need those precise coefficient definitions and full all-order argument, not a free-coefficient refutation. No proof claim.'),
345512:('pathchromatic','Section 5; Theorems 5.4–5.5; closing conjecture','PARK_HARD','The source proves NP-completeness at threshold six and poses threshold two afterward. A polynomial-size sequence of bags with proper two-colourings can certify membership in NP after redundant bags are removed; hardness at six does not transfer downward automatically. Need an explicit polynomial reduction preserving yes/no at two; none derived.'),
345546:('discs','Intro and Fernique–Pchelina arXiv:2104.12458v2 pp1–2','EXCLUDE_PUBLIC_REFUTATION','The companion explicitly states that the densest compact packing being saturated is insufficient, gives algebraic radius polynomials, and constructs a denser noncompact packing. Its density computation uses attached Sage code, which was not run or retrieved here, and figures were not visually inspected. This is a concrete prior exact-scope refutation claim with a read primary construction, not lane discovery; no independent numerical certificate claimed.'),
345553:('list-arboricity','Conjecture 2.4, p5','PARK_HARD','Source explicitly distinguishes this bounded-order conjecture from a different conjecture it refutes. For k=1 a forest admits every one-element list since any induced subgraph is a forest, but that does not address arbitrary k. Hall matching colours injectively proves only the stronger availability regime and not |V|<=3k. Need a list partition into k induced forests for every such G; no general mechanism.'),
345596:('feedback','Definition 14; Conjecture 19, p13','HOLD_FIDELITY','Primary Q(m,n) is a toroidal Cartesian product of cycles, m,n>=2, with vertex-independent start, whereas the literal record says rectangular grid. Source absence of even kernels for coprime m,n is only absence of a sufficient Bob certificate, not an Alice strategy. Cannot conflate either convention or count a domain correction. Need a full coprime toroidal strategy and separate literal interpretation review.'),
345603:('treegroups','Conjecture 4.41; Definition 4.42 and Proposition 4.43','PARK_HARD','Source equates the finiteness question to bounded CD dimension and proves dimension one exactly for regular local action. Semiprimitivity permits nontrivial point stabilizers; the regular case does not bound all local extension depths. Need a uniform depth/stabilizer bound depending on F or an infinite nonconjugate family; neither obtained. No primitive-only transfer claimed.'),
345705:('connectivity','Conjecture 8.4; Examples 7.1 and 8.3','PARK_HARD','Both literal branches match the final displayed bounds. Clique-sum extremal examples supply lower constructions, not universal upper bounds. Decomposing at a k-separator counts separator edges repeatedly; the precise lower-order potential needed through unequal atoms is unpaid. Boundary k=1/forests and equality examples cannot replace all k,n.'),
345786:('additive','Definitions 2.1/2.3; Conjecture 3.1 and Statement 3.3','HOLD_CONSTRAINED_INFIMA','SUSTAINED-ROUTES.md Route C: unrestricted alpha<=beta<=alpha^2 is already proved. Equality with isometric/isomeric variants remains unpaid. Disjoint unions and tensor replication add self-sums; no full symmetrization inequality or strict counterexample obtained.'),
345787:('additive','Conjecture 4.1; Theorem 4.2; Statement 4.3','HOLD_CONSTRAINED_FIBERS','SUSTAINED-ROUTES.md Route B: reproduced unrestricted beta coset bound, then tested equal-size, same-set, containment, and nonsplit quotient routes. All-six claim is unpaid; exact missing constrained fiber lemma recorded. Beta-only or torsion-free-product cases earn no solution credit.'),
345788:('additive','Conjecture 5.1; Statements 5.3–5.4','HOLD_REVERSE_QUOTIENT','SUSTAINED-ROUTES.md Route C: full-fiber lifts prove source-known theta(U)<=theta(Uprime). Nonuniform projected fibers defeat direct denominator transfer in reverse. Missing sharp constrained fiber-profile inequality identified; no candidate counterexample with a global infimum certificate.'),
345792:('additive','Definitions 8.1–8.4; Conjecture 9.2','HOLD_DISTRIBUTION_COUPLING','SUSTAINED-ROUTES.md Route B: arbitrary coset restriction destroys identical distributions, and same-function comparison does not permit different restrictions. Existing gamma_p independence does not close gamma-prime/gamma-double-prime. Need a distribution-preserving max-convolution coupling. Signed l1 wording also needs fidelity review.'),
345796:('stranded','Conjecture 1, eq31; Proposition 2, eq32; Proposition 3','PARK_HARD','The exact alpha(G)<=val P_G is Conjecture 1. The proved proposition has factor two; existence of large-D limit is weaker. Reduction to 2PI is read, and triangle straight-ahead cycles are the explicit obstruction to their inductive method. The record solved-reference text does not resolve this stronger graph-by-graph bound. Need factor-one cancellation control for all 2PI graphs.'),
345852:('rigidity','Conjecture 17; appended corrigendum pp19–21','EXCLUDE_PUBLIC_REFUTATION','2023 v2 explicitly refutes the exact iff and even its d=2,t=3 special claim. Read full corrected Lemma 1 proof and Lemma 2 proof/captions. Figure adjacency not independently reconstructed. Proper containment of a circuit in a summand is the failed inference; source-known counterexamples cannot be credited anew.'),
345896:('tightcuts','Conjecture 1.9; Theorem 1.11 and Section 3 proof','EXCLUDE_PUBLIC_PROOF','Chen–Feng–Lu–Lucchesi–Zhang arXiv:2003.08622v1, March 2020, Theorem 1.11 supplies a C-sheltered barrier or a laminar 2-separation cut. By the stated preceding barrier-to-cut implication this gives the exact nontrivial laminar ELP cut. Read theorem, definitions, and concluding induction cases. Complete target-level prior reduction; no new result.'),
345907:('closure','Conjectures 1–2 and density definition, pp1–2','PARK_FLAGSHIP','Primary source presents the closure induction as equivalent to Frankl via density, not solved. It excludes empty sets, unlike the literal unrestricted 2^[n] wording; exploiting a degenerate empty family would be an endpoint correction. Mere abundance in closure does not descend because added members may disproportionately contain an element. Need a genuine density-descent abundance argument in full scope.'),
346033:('hot','Sections 2.1–2.3; Assumption 4.1; Conjecture 8.1','HOLD_SOURCE_AND_QUALIFICATION','SUSTAINED-ROUTES.md Route A supplies a full ordinary reduction to real quantifier elimination with all eigenspace/global quantifiers, endpoint charts and component dichotomy. Auxiliary theorem primary source retrieval timed out; final journal body not verified from landing HTML. Novelty/significance and realistic Lean implementation remain unqualified. No generic unknown-literature veto asserted.'),
381597:('spectral','Conjecture 5.1 and reduction after it, p18','HOLD_ARITHMETIC','Source reduces odd c_alpha/even n case to proving every rational orthogonal intertwiner has odd level; its odd-prime theorem does not handle the 2-adic obstruction. Fn and c_alpha are source-defined and literal record does not specify rational-parameter conventions. Need the missing level parity argument or exact graph witness; finite spectra evidence would not suffice.')}
provenance=json.loads(Path('exact20-provenance.json').read_text()); results={};
for x in provenance:
 i=x['id']; name,labels,status,note=notes[i]; raw=Path('raw/'+str(i)+'.jsonl').read_bytes(); assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==x['raw_sha256']; st=x['object']['statement']; src='sources/'+name+'.pdf'
 results[str(i)]={'mathdb_id':i,'title':x['object']['title'],'literal_statement':st,'provenance':{k:x[k] for k in ['chunk','chunk_sha256','line','raw_sha256']},'statement_utf8_sha256':hashlib.sha256(st.encode()).hexdigest(),'raw_saved_path':'raw/'+str(i)+'.jsonl','disposition':status,'analysis':note,'source_body':src,'source_labels':labels,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(src).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'gates':{'literal':{'status':'READ_PRESERVED','full_original_object':True},'source':{'status':'BODY_PASSAGES_READ','limits':'Relevant text passages; not whole-paper proof audit; source-specific caveats in analysis.'},'math':{'status':'ORDINARY_REDUCTION_ONLY' if i==346033 else ('PRIOR_RESULT' if status.startswith('EXCLUDE') else 'NO_COMPLETE_FULL_SCOPE_PROOF'),'details':note},'prior':{'status':'EXACT_PUBLIC_COUNTERPART' if status.startswith('EXCLUDE') else 'BOUNDED_UNCLEARED','history':'historical-checks.json: permitted completed exact paths only; no ID hits','registries':'registry-inventory.json: live roots/heads only; no recursive theorem-body clearance'},'novelty':{'status':'FAIL_KNOWN' if status.startswith('EXCLUDE') else 'HOLD_NOT_ESTABLISHED'},'significance':{'status':'ZERO_NEW_CONTRIBUTION' if status.startswith('EXCLUDE') else 'NOT_ADJUDICATED','limit':'No boundary/helper/known-case credit.'},'formal':{'status':'NOT_EXECUTED_NOT_AUTHORIZED','literal_endpoint':False},'independent':{'status':'NOT_REVIEWED','self_check':'SUSTAINED-ROUTES.md is not independent review'},'acceptance':{'status':'NOT_ACCEPTED','credit':0}}}
assert len(results)==20 and set(map(int,results))==set(json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','results.json'],input=json.dumps(results,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False),text=True,capture_output=True); assert p.returncode==0
print('Exactly twenty keyed results, nine distinct gates each, zero credit.')
